body: The cellar door creaks as I push open its thick oak frame. Inside, the smell intensifies—ozone mixed with musty earth and a hint of decay. I close my eyes for a moment, trying to breathe through the overwhelming stench. When I reopen them, the room feels smaller, darker, and more claustrophobic. My heart races faster with each passing second. I step forward cautiously, the air now suffocatingly heavy.
